resources.string: Viewing one source. Tap Back to flow to show all sources.
Tap Refresh to fetch articles from this source.
Tap a source to read all its downloaded articles.

Tap a source in All sources to open its complete downloaded feed. The background turns light green. This view ignores Time depth, tag filters and the visible-item limit. Tap Back to flow or use Android Back to restore your previous view and filters. Feed download limits still apply.
